title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of 0.3525, 0.0, 0.0. Next, create a new face within this coordinate system. On this face, draw a single loop and within this loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates (0.0225, 0.0225) with a radius of 0.0225. Apply a scale factor of 0.045 to the entire 2D sketch to adjust its size accordingly. Rotate the 2D sketch using the Euler angles defined in the coordinate system and translate it using the specified translation vector. Extrude the 2D sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to transform it into a 3D cylindrical base. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. This process will create a new solid body with dimensions of 0.045 units in length, 0.045 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the circle for the cylindrical section
circle_center = (0.0225, 0.0225)
circle_radius = 0.0225

# Create the circle in the XY plane
r = r.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the circle to create the cylindrical section
extrude_depth = 0.75
r = r.extrude(extrude_depth)

# Translate the cylindrical section to the specified position
translation_vector = (0.3525, 0.0, 0.0)
r = r.translate(translation_vector)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0225, 0.0225)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0225)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)  # Extrude the circle to create the cylinder
)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

# Create a workplane for the 2D sketch
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the cylinder parameters
cylinder_diameter = 0.045
cylinder_length = 0.75
radius = cylinder_diameter / 2

# Create a 2D sketch of a circle
r = r.moveTo(radius, 0).circle(radius)

# Revolve the sketch to create the 3D cylinder
r = r.extrude(cylinder_length)
